scientific_integrity: The proof is an all-length valuation/prefix argument plus exact counting of power-of-four shells; finite code checks are corroborative. Originality is conditional on accessible primary literature and mathematical-index comparisons, not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: The bound concerns positive integer quotients of canonical binary antipalindromes. The exact \(19/54\) density is for an explicit forbidden subset; the density of the entire complement is not determined, and the zero-density conjecture for representables is not resolved.
title: A \(19/54\) lower-density obstruction for binary antipalindrome quotients
